1.consolidated_definition: Ser hipócrita, santurrón, bobo. “¡Despabílate! ¡Pareces un juey dormío!” Agüero.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To be hypocritical, sanctimonious, or foolish. "Wake up! You look like a sleepy donkey!" (Literal translation of "juey dormío" preserves the cultural reference to a common Puerto Rican expression).
